tools.name: site_search
tools.description: Search the published content of www.accentvoice.com (pages, blog posts, products, customer stories). All query terms must match; title hits rank highest. Returns up to `limit` results with collection, slug (absent for pages), route, title and score. Use site_get to read a result in full.

tools.name: site_get
tools.description: Fetch one published record in full. Pass exactly one of `route` (e.g. "/cloud-phone-system/") or `slug` (looked up as product, then post, then page, then story). Returns a not_found error if nothing is published there.

tools.name: site_status
tools.description: The schema version and release stamp (git, build time, digest) of the content being served. It equals the stamp in /agent/content-index.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: site_search, site_get · Private data: site_get · Public sink: site_get.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: site_search, site_get · Private data: site_get · Public sink: site_get

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: site_search, site_get · Private data: site_get · Public sink: site_get, get_budgetary_quote

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "site_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the published content of www.accentvoice.com (pages, blog posts, products, customer stories). All query terms must match; title hits rank highest. Returns up to `limit` results with collection, slug (absent for pages), route, title and score. Use site_get to read a result in full." → after: "Search the published content of www.accentvoice.com (pages, blog posts, products, customer stories). Plain questions work: filler words are ignored, results are ranked by how many terms match (title first), and broad questions return the overview pages. Returns up to `limit` results with collection,"

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
